How to Pack Fragile Items for Moving

How to protect fragile items during a move.

Author: Ralph Ivey

Last updated: 2026-07-20

Experience: Written for working trucking and moving businesses.

Answer

Use strong boxes, enough padding, and careful stacking so fragile items are protected from crush and impact.
